# Configuration reference

<!-- GENERATED by tools/docs/render_config_reference.py from the pydantic section models; do not edit. -->

One YAML file configures a run; each top-level key is a section validated by a strict pydantic model
(`extra="forbid"`: unknown sections and keys are errors). Relative paths in `md.executable`,
`md.initial_structure` and `mlip.source_path` resolve against the config file's directory.
Validate with `gmd-al validate-config --config run.yaml`; `configs/default.yaml` holds every key at its
default and `configs/sections/*.yaml` document each section. Units: A, eV, eV/A, eV/A^3, fs.
Descriptions come from the model's field descriptions, else from the inline comments of
`configs/sections/<section>.yaml`; topic pages explain the semantics ([monitoring](monitoring.md),
[extraction and datasets](extraction_and_datasets.md), [labeling and scheduling](labeling_and_scheduling.md),
[SCF tooling](scf/README.md), [architecture](architecture.md)).

Required sections: `workflow`, `md`, `mlip`, `cp2k`. Every other section is optional and
uses its defaults when absent.

| Section | Model |
|---|---|
| [`workflow`](#workflow) | `gmd_active_learning.workflow.controller.WorkflowConfig` |
| [`md`](#md) | `gmd_active_learning.adapters.gmd.engine.GMDConfig` |

## events

Rolling pre/post-trigger capture (PHAL ``buffer`` section) plus cooldown and bounded history.

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `events.enabled` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `events.pre_trigger_frames` | int | `10` | >= 0 |  |
| `events.post_trigger_frames` | int | `5` | >= 0 |  |
| `events.maxlen` | int \| null | `null` | >= 1 | rolling history length; null = pre_trigger_frames + 1 |
| `events.cooldown_steps` | int | `0` | >= 0 | MD steps after an event's last frame during which new triggers open no event |
| `events.retain_recent` | int | `16` | >= 0 | number of finished-event summaries kept in memory (bounded, F-07) |
| `events.store` | section `EventStoreConfig` | | |  |
| `events.store.enabled` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `events.store.directory` | str \| null | `null` |  | event root directory; required when enabled |
| `events.store.write_extxyz` | bool | `true` |  | also write frames.extxyz (frames.npz is always written, bit-exact) |

The ``scf`` configuration section.
